title: Stonehenge

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Stonehenges are permanent structures found in Plains. They are a formation of large boulders placed on top of each other, either in a circle or by themselves.

sections.heading: Resources
sections.text:
Stonehenges comes in 6 variants. Each variant features one or more of the following features:
• A chance for a Vegvisir that marks the location of the closest Yagluth's Forsaken Altars.
• A chance for a Stonehenge Center Chest that rarely contains a Fuling totem.
• A chance for Fuling berserkers or Fulings protecting the zone.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Stonehenges were inspired by their real-life counterpart of the same name found in Wiltshire, England. The real pre-historic monument is said to have been constructed over 5000 years ago.

Introduction. Stonehenges are permanent structures found in Plains. They are a formation of large boulders placed on top of each other, either in a circle or by themselves.

Resources. Stonehenges comes in 6 variants. Each variant features one or more of the following features:
• A chance for a Vegvisir that marks the location of the closest Yagluth's Forsaken Altars.
• A chance for a Stonehenge Center Chest that rarely contains a Fuling totem.
• A chance for Fuling berserkers or Fulings protecting the zone.

Notes. • Stonehenges were inspired by their real-life counterpart of the same name found in Wiltshire, England. The real pre-historic monument is said to have been constructed over 5000 years ago.
